Get ACB Player Data

Source: R/acb.R
acb_player_data.Rd

Player biography: birth, nationality, height, current team and social links.

One row. birth_date is a date (the API sends DD-MM-YYYY); height_m is metres (the API sends '2,20', a decimal comma); birth_country / nationality are Spanish with ISO alpha-2 in *_iso; licensing is the licence code as sent (for example EUR or JFL; meanings unverified). The current team columns are the player's team entry for the edition.

Endpoint: GET https://api2.acb.com/api/seasondata/PlayerProfile/player-data

Usage

acb_player_data(player_id)

Arguments

player_id

(required) ACB licence number (integer): the person id everywhere (box score, play-by-play, shots, rosters). 20209407 = Edy Tavares, 20212243 = Olek Balcerowski. A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "acb_player_data")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in acb_match_header().

See also

family_acb lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(acb_player_data(player_id = 20209407))
#> ── ACB Player Data from api2.acb.com ──────────────────────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-11-09 19:08:52 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 28
#>   player_id player_name first_name last_name shirt_number game_role
#>       <int> <chr>       <chr>      <chr>     <chr>        <chr>    
#> 1  20209407 Edy Tavares Walter     Tavares   22           Pívot    
#> # ℹ 22 more variables: is_license_active <lgl>, licensing <chr>,
#> #   birth_date <date>, birth_place <chr>, birth_country <chr>,
#> #   birth_country_iso <chr>, nationality <chr>, nationality_iso <chr>,
#> #   height_m <dbl>, player_number <int>, team_id <int>, club_id <int>,
#> #   team <chr>, team_abbr <chr>, edition_id <int>, season <int>,
#> #   instagram <chr>, twitter <chr>, facebook <chr>, youtube <chr>,
#> #   tiktok <chr>, pronunciation_url <chr>
# }
